constructor.details: Deployed directly, not behind a proxy.

getFee(uint64,(bytes,bytes,(address,uint.details: This takes EVM2AnyMessage (instead of MessageV1) because the router client API that user contracts interact with exposes EVM2AnyMessage. The onRamp can translate to MessageV1 internally where required (e.g., verifier or executor hooks), but using EVM2AnyMessage here keeps the interface aligned with what clients construct and pass to the router.

params.destChainSelector: The destination chain selector of the message.
params.extraArgs: Opaque extra args that can be used by the fee quoter,

returns.allowedSendersList: list of addresses that are allowed to send messages to the remote chain.
returns.remoteChainConfig: The struct containing the remote chain settings.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

params.to: The address to which ownership will be transferred.

versionTag().details: Used by operational tooling. Verifiers implemented by CLL override this function.

acceptOwnership().notice: Allows an ownership transfer to be completed by the recipient.

applyAllowlistUpdates((uint64,bool,addre.notice: Updates sender allowlists. Callable by the owner or the allowlist admin.

forwardToVerifier((uint64,uint64,uint64,.notice: Returns the version tag and message ID as verifier data, after the RMN and allowlist checks.

getAllowedFinalityConfig().notice: Gets the finality config as defined in the FinalityCodec library. This value does NOT 1:1 translate to a block depth. The finality config contains special flags and should only be encoded/decoded using the FinalityCodec library. Checks must happen by calling `FinalityCodec._ensureRequestedFinalityAllowed`.

getDynamicConfig().notice: Returns the fee aggregator and allowlist admin.

getFee(uint64,(bytes,bytes,(address,uint.notice: Quotes the fee, including gas and calldata bytes, for a CCIP message to a destination chain.

getRemoteChainConfig(uint64).notice: get ChainConfig configured for the remoteChainSelector.

getStorageLocations().notice: Returns the storage location identifiers for this CCV. Each entry uniquely identifies a storage location. This can be an address, a URL, or any other identifier that makes sense for the CCV. The format of the strings is up to the CCV implementer, but it should be something that can be easily parsed and used by the integrator. This is used by the executor(s) to know where to look for the proof data that the CCV has produced.

setDynamicConfig((address,address)).notice: Sets the fee aggregator and allowlist admin.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Allows an owner to begin transferring ownership to a new address. The new owner needs to call `acceptOwnership` to accept the transfer before any permissions are changed.

verifyMessage((uint64,uint64,uint64,uint.notice: Accepts a message whose verifier results carry the version tag and its message ID. Checks no proof.

versionTag().notice: Exposes the version tag for outbound requests.

withdrawFeeTokens(address[]).notice: Sends the contract's balance of each fee token to the fee aggregator. Callable by anyone.
